1.consolidated_definition: Director joven de una empresa o negocio con menos experiencia que un senior manager. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Demanda de empleo: Junior manager, busco empleo en empresa de consumo masivo o industrial, de preferencia multinacional/transnacional (Mundo Anuncio.com, 19-08-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Young executive in charge of a company or business with less experience than a senior manager. Raw anglicism, relatively uncommon. Job demand: Junior manager, seeking employment in a mass consumer or industrial company, preferably multinational/transnational (Mundo Anuncio.com, 19-08-07)
